description:
Elixir raises ArgumentError for String.replace_leading/3 and String.replace_trailing/3 when match is "", because replacing every repeated zero-width occurrence cannot make progress. fz deliberately guards the zero byte-size recursion but currently returns the subject unchanged, silently masking the invalid operation.

Prove both functions across interp, run, and build; choose the existing fz error authority for invalid runtime arguments; document the empty-match contract. This is separate from fz-5xp.91: prefix/suffix replacement has one finite empty match, and ordinary split/replace has finitely many grapheme boundaries, while leading/trailing repetition has no finite result.
title: [BUG] String.replace_leading/3 and replace_trailing/3 silently accept an empty match
